usedFor: Each “New Invoice” in QuickBooks adds the customer to ActiveCampaign with “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice” in QuickBooks, then “Create Contact” in ActiveCampaign
bestTemplate.why: Each invoice brings a real paying customer into ActiveCampaign.

watchOut: A customer with several invoices runs “Create Contact” several times, so check how repeats are handled.
